verdict.rationale: Bolna docs confirm STT provider choice (Deepgram, Azure, ElevenLabs, etc.), custom LLM support via OpenAI-compatible base_url, and transcript/recording access via call history and quickstart flow, giving developers real control over STT and language model selection. However, there is no evidence of fine-grained transcription accuracy controls like custom vocabulary, key-term/keyword boosting, or STT-specific tuning parameters. Missing for 10: explicit support for key-term/vocabulary boosting or custom dictionary controls for STT accuracy, and independent verification of real-time transcription accuracy.
